description: Validated European subset of UCDP GED, produced by `python -m src.pipeline build`.
licence: CC BY 4.0 - Davies, Shawn, Therése Pettersson & Magnus Öberg (2026). Organized violence 1989-2025. Journal of Peace Research; Sundberg, Ralph & Erik Melander (2013). Introducing the UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset. Journal of Peace Research 50(4).

checks.name: date_parse
checks.detail: Formats used: {'%Y-%m-%d': 58016}. Unparseable or empty dates: 0.

checks.name: date_format_consistency
checks.detail: 0 dates were not in the primary format '%Y-%m-%d' and were parsed with an explicit secondary format.

checks.name: fatality_bounds_ordered
checks.detail: Expected low <= best <= high for every event.

checks.name: year_matches_date
checks.detail: UCDP 'year' should equal the year of date_start.

checks.name: duplicate_event_ids
checks.detail: 0 rows repeat an event id already seen.

checks.name: country_harmonisation
checks.detail: All country names mapped to ISO3.

checks.name: coordinates_inside_stated_country
checks.detail: 1177 points fall more than 10 km outside the stated country (Natural Earth 1:50m, present-day borders). Top stated countries: {'Serbia': 1016, 'Russia': 91, 'Ukraine': 69, 'Malta': 1}. Expected where the source codes the state that existed at the time (UCDP: 'Serbia (Yugoslavia)' for 1991-99 events in Croatia, Bosnia and Kosovo; 'Russia (Soviet Union)' for 1989-91 events in the Caucasus) and in contested areas (Natural Earth draws Crimea as Russia; UCDP codes it Ukraine).

checks.name: possible_duplicate_events
checks.detail: 10822 rows share ['event_date', 'latitude', 'longitude', 'event_type'] with at least one other row under a different id. Not removed: same-day events at the same coordinates can be distinct.

checks.name: missing_fatalities
checks.detail: 0 null values in 'fatalities'. Nulls are kept as missing, never filled with 0.

checks.name: missing_admin1
checks.detail: 12539 null values in 'admin1'. Nulls are kept as missing, never filled with 0.

transformations: Selected UCDP region containing 'Europe': 58016 of 417968 global events.
event_date = date_start (events spanning several days are dated by their start).
date_uncertain = date_prec > 1 (date known only to a range of days or wider).
location_precise = where_prec in {1, 2} (exact place or within ~25 km).
event_type = UCDP type_of_violence label; fatalities = UCDP 'best' estimate.
Country names mapped to ISO3 (e.g. 'Russia (Soviet Union)' -> RUS).
